title: Estimation of Continuous-Time Markov Processes Sampled at Random Time Intervals
annotation: Develops estimation under random arrivals, including state-dependent intensities. The mixture-clock note instead fixes independent finite exponential mixtures and discards realized durations and component labels; random-time identification itself is classical.

authors: Higham, N. J. and Lin, L.
title: On pth roots of stochastic matrices
annotation: Treats primary and nonprimary matrix roots and stochastic roots. The mixture-clock note uses principal-square-root uniqueness to select the globally correct two-rate generator inverse, rather than choosing an arbitrary root.
